map.字母重排组合数 = 字母数 n 的阶乘 ÷（各重复字母出现次数阶乘之积）；从字母: Anagram combinations = n! / product of (each repeated letter count!); enumerate subsets of length >=3 from the letter set, generate full permutations, compare against a dictionary and deduplicate to get all spellable words; output sorted by descending length or alphabetical order, with scores often based on word length or rarity.

map.单词训练：给定一组英文字母，找出能拼出的所有 ≥3 字母英文单词，练词汇与拼写。: Vocabulary training: given a set of English letters, find all spellable English words of >=3 letters to practice vocabulary and spelling.
map.英语教学：按长度或字典序排列结果，用于课堂单词拓展与拼写竞赛。: English teaching: sort results by length or alphabetical order for classroom vocabulary expansion and spelling contests.
map.脑力锻炼：限定时间内尽可能多拼词，记录命中数与最长词。: Brain exercise: within a time limit, spell as many words as possible and record the hit count and longest word.
map.输入或随机给一组字母（如 6 个），工具按字典穷举所有「字母不重复使用」且长度: Input or randomly get a set of letters (e.g. 6), the tool exhaustively enumerates all subsequences that use each letter at most once and have length >=3, checks each against a word list, and lists the hits; results can be sorted by descending length or alphabetical order.
map.字母组 LISTEN 可重排出 SILENT、TINSEL、ENLIST、INL: The letter set LISTEN can rearrange into SILENT, TINSEL, ENLIST, INLETS, LISTEN, etc.; taking 5-letter subsets yields LINES, TILES, SLIME, EMITS, ISLET, etc. The full permutations of 6 distinct letters is 6! = 720, but valid English words are a small fraction, so the tool only outputs dictionary hits.
map.默认每个给定字母在同一单词里至多使用一次（对应原词字母多重数）；若原词含重复字母: By default each given letter is used at most once per word (matching the letter multiplicity of the source); if the source has repeated letters, reuse within that multiplicity is allowed.
map.720 种排列里绝大多数是乱序非词，只有通过词表校验的才列出，故有效词通常十几个: Of the 720 permutations, the vast majority are scrambled non-words; only those passing the word-list check are listed, so the valid words usually number from a dozen to a few dozen.
